notes.title: Discover the Demo with the Devs
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CtVDPPLnBIY;full][/previewyoutube]

💥 Today, Ghislain from Pixel Almost Perfect, would like to present the Steam demo of OctaRace. An explosive racing game that pays homage to old multiplayer arcade racing games such as MicroMachines.

The game's Kickstarter campaign is currently underway, and your support will allow us to communicate about the game, secure physical production costs, and think about long term support (content, features, online) 💚

Enjoy a family-friendly arcade experience on PC & Consoles (Switch 2 included!) with quick sessions and instant handling. With a "feel-good" spirit and a retro ambiance reminiscent of the PlayStation 1 era, OctaRace provides a colorful and welcoming atmosphere.

Coming in 2025, so get those engines started! 🚗
Join the crowdfunding : https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/...

Creation by Pixel Almost Perfect
Publisher: https://www.pixelheart.eu

notes.title: OctaRace is coming to KickStarter! 💚
notes.content:
The OctaRace crowdfunding campaign is launching very soon on Kickstarter! 💚
You can already follow the pre-launch page so you don't miss the big launch!
👉 https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelalmostperfect/octarace

With this event just around the corner, it's time to tell us a little more about us!
[b]Pixel Almost Perfect[/b] is an independent video game studio of just two people, which we've been passionately supporting since 2018.
OctaRace, the studio's second project, is the result of more than three years of hard work in our free time, lunchtimes, evenings, and weekends.
[b]PixelHeart[/b], our publisher on OctaRace, allowed us to work with incredible guests without whom we wouldn't have come this far: Alexis Laugier, Simon "Hutt" Trousellier, Pierre-Alexandre Rouillon, Charles Duchesne, and Alexis Séreuse. A huge thank you to all of you. 🔥

OctaRace is scheduled for release this year, 2025.
Thank you for your support! 🚗💨

notes.title: Update Demo v0.2.1966
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

Thank you all for playing the demo & sharing feedbacks!
We addressed some major issues you've reported :

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Keyboard inputs icons are displayed in interface if no controllers detected
[*] Add bot difficulty options easy and hard (OctaRace mode)
[*] Add subtle score progression gauge for each individual score (OctaRace mode)
[*] Feedback clarification if the winner of the round is not the winner of the game (OctaRace mode)
[*] Camera improvements (OctaRace mode)
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Input not working in some cases
[*] Online bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

Have fun!
[b]Team Pixel Almost Perfect[/b]

notes.title: First contact
notes.content:
Dear OctaRace pilots,

Let's begin by a warm [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all!
Playing our demo & wishlisting the game can't be more important for us. Your trust help us to make the game better & being confident in the near future. With [b]OctaRace [/b]we are determined to create a great tribute to arcade racing games we loved.

Our huge team of two people is working hard since 2 years now (on our free time), we are eager to finally show you our passion for fat pixels.
With this project we are searching to retrieve the emotions we lived when we were kids, sharing a pad with friends in a couch, yelling and laughing at each damned injustice.
We strongly believe in neo-retro games, and are proud to be part of it with [b]OctaRace[/b].

This demo is still a work in progress version of the game, there is so much more content & features to come but you have the rough idea of what we want to achieve.
Supported by PixelHeart, we are aiming a final version [b]end of 2024[/b] for [b]PC & Consoles[/b], digital & physical versions. 

Thanks again for your support & kindness, 
Stay tuned for more!

Ghislain & Adrien
[b]Pixel Almost Perfect[/b]
